name: io.github.fr0ster/mcp-abap-adt
description: MCP server for SAP ABAP ADT: repository analysis and CRUD for RAP and classic ABAP

environmentVariables.name: SAP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the ABAP system (on-prem host or BTP ABAP service URL). Required to connect.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_AUTH_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: 'xsuaa' for JWT/OAuth2 (BTP ABAP Cloud) or 'basic' for username/password (on-prem).

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SYSTEM_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Controls which tools are available (e.g. Programs are onprem-only).

environmentVariables.name: SAP_CLIENT
environmentVariables.description: ABAP client/mandant number. Optional for BTP ABAP Cloud.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_JWT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: JWT bearer token for SAP_AUTH_TYPE=xsuaa. Never commit; supply via environment or the developer's own secret store.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for SAP_AUTH_TYPE=basic (on-prem). Never commit; supply via environment or the developer's own secret store.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_MASTER_SYSTEM
environmentVariables.description: System context for on-prem create/update operations (e.g. DEV).

environmentVariables.name: SAP_RESPONSIBLE
environmentVariables.description: Responsible user for on-prem create/update operations.

packages.note: No version pinned deliberately; the project chooses whether to pin in its own .mcp.json. Credentials are never written to this file or to .mcp.json in git, per connector.md's 'Never' section.
